The WNBA Finals resume in Atlanta tied 1-1, and the NBA's first big night opens with Luka Doncic's Lakers against Stephen Curry's Warriors. Here are the best prices on those games, Heat vs Timberwolves, Bayern vs Arsenal and the NHL. Wednesday's card has WNBA Finals Game 3 with the series tied 1-1, an 11-game NBA slate led by Lakers vs Warriors, midweek college football, Bayern Munich vs Arsenal and two NHL games. The price that stands out most is the Under 151.5 in Game 3 at -108 on FanDuel, a total neither Finals game has come close to. Odds below compare FanDuel, Fanatics, BetRivers, DraftKings and LetsBetMD (Maryland only). They were taken this morning, and all times are ET. Golden State won Game 1 68-64, and Atlanta answered with a 79-65 win in Game 2 at Chase Center to draw level before the series heads east. The Dream are 3.5-point favorites at home and about -160 on the moneyline, which looks fair for the side. The total is where the market looks off. The first two games produced 132 and 144 points, and tonight's number is 151.5. That number is built for a faster game than this series has delivered. Game 1 finished 19.5 points below this line and Game 2 finished 7.5 below it. The risk is a late foul-fest: an Under that looks safe with five minutes left can be undone at the free-throw line. It stops being a bet below 148. BET VALKYRIES VS DREAM AT FANDUEL Warriors Vs Lakers Odds: Spread, Moneyline And Total Both teams open their season at Crypto.com Arena, and it is the Lakers' first game without LeBron James, who signed with the 76ers in the offseason. The offense runs through Luka Doncic, who averaged 33.5 points last season. The Lakers went 43-21 in the games he played and 28-13 at home overall. Golden State's injury list is long. Jimmy Butler, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Brandin Podziemski are out, and Stephen Curry is probable after spraining his right ankle in practice. Curry averaged 26.6 points in 43 games last season, and the Warriors were 13-26 without him. They were also 15-26 on the road. The spread opened at -7.5 early this week and is now -6.5 at every book here that offers it. The move looks like respect for last season's opener, a 119-109 Warriors win in Los Angeles, but the Lakers won the next three meetings by 6, 28 and 16 points. At -6.5 the value is with the home side. The moneyline is not a serious option at -208. Doncic against a thin Warriors rotation is the edge, and the line has shed a point since Monday. The risk is Curry: if the ankle is fine and he gets hot from deep, a seven-point margin is far from safe. It stops being a bet at -8. Timberwolves Vs Heat Odds: Spread, Moneyline And Total Minnesota was the stronger team on both ends last season: 49-33, a +3.1 net rating that ranked 10th and the eighth-best defensive rating in the league. Anthony Edwards averaged 28.8 points, and the Wolves went 23-18 on the road. Miami finished 43-39 but was 26-15 at home, and the Heat played at the fastest pace in the NBA while averaging 120.9 points. The books make this a near pick'em, with Miami a 1.5-point favorite. Even money on the team with the better profile is the value here. Minnesota's defense is the better unit, and the moneyline beats taking +1.5 at -108 or worse. The risk is Miami's tempo: if the Heat turn this into a track meet at home, the edge narrows. This is one for normal stakes, not a big play. BET TIMBERWOLVES VS HEAT AT BETRIVERS New Mexico State Vs Sam Houston Odds: Spread, Moneyline And Total Two struggling Conference USA teams meet at Sam Houston. The Bearkats are 1-5 (0-2 in conference) and have scored three points in each of their last two games, losses of 35-3 to Liberty and 16-3 to Western Kentucky. New Mexico State is 2-4 (1-1) and beat that same Western Kentucky team 34-13. The Aggies have not played since a 22-3 loss at FIU on Oct. 7. Sam Houston has allowed 200.3 rushing yards per game, a problem against an Aggies offense that runs for 142.7 per game. The worry on the other side is ball security: New Mexico State has lost 11 turnovers and forced six, and it is 0-3 away from home. New Mexico State is -2.5 at every book, and -110 at FanDuel and BetRivers is the best price; DraftKings is -115, LetsBetMD -114 and Fanatics -116. Sam Houston's best moneyline is +117 at LetsBetMD. BetRivers had Sam Houston at +135 on Monday and is at +110 now, so money has come in on the home side. That looks generous to a team averaging 19.5 points. Bet to consider: New Mexico State -2.5 at -110 on FanDuel or BetRivers. The common result against Western Kentucky and the Bearkats' run defense point the same way. The risk is the Aggies' turnover habit on the road, so this is one for small stakes. Bayern Munich Vs Arsenal Odds: Champions League Moneyline And Draw Arsenal are the only team yet to concede in this season's Champions League, 2-0 with four goals scored, and they sit second in the Premier League at 6-0-1. Bayern lead the Bundesliga unbeaten at 4-2-0 with 22 goals in six league games, but they will be without Michael Olise, who is suspended after his red card against Viking FK. In the three-way market Bayern's best price is +107 at LetsBetMD, the draw is +290 at DraftKings and Arsenal is +240 at BetRivers. Arsenal have drifted all week: FanDuel had them at +200 on Sunday and is at +230 now, while BetRivers moved from +215 to +240. The market is leaning hard on Bayern's home record and attack. I would rather take +240 on the side that has not conceded than lay a short price on Bayern without Olise. Bet to consider: Arsenal to win at +240 on BetRivers. The value is in the drift. The risk is obvious: Bayern's 22 league goals say they will create chances, so keep the stake small. BET BAYERN VS ARSENAL AT FANATICS Panthers Vs Senators Odds: Moneyline And Total Ottawa and Florida arrive level on 12 points. The Senators are 6-3-0 and 3-1-0 at Canadian Tire Centre; the Panthers are 5-2-2 and have won three straight. The moneyline is a coin flip: Ottawa is -108 at BetRivers, DraftKings and FanDuel, and Florida's best is -110 at BetRivers. Goaltending is Ottawa's strength. Linus Ullmark has a .945 save percentage and a 1.33 goals-against average in seven starts. Scoring is the weakness: the Senators rank 25th in goals per game at 2.44 and 29th on the power play at 12.8%. Florida scores 3.33 goals per game but allows only 24.0 shots, fourth-fewest in the league. Both teams play again Thursday, so neither starter is guaranteed. Bet to consider: Under 5.5 goals at +105 on DraftKings or Fanatics. An Ottawa team that struggles to score plus a Florida side that limits shots points to a low total, and plus money on the Under is the better side of the 5.5. The risk is the goalie choice on the first night of a back-to-back; it stops being a bet at -120. Line Moves To Watch Three moves stand out. The Lakers spread has dropped from -7.5 to -6.5 at DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers and Fanatics. Arsenal have drifted from +215 to +240 at BetRivers while Bayern shortened from +118 to +102 there. Sam Houston has come in from +135 to +110 at BetRivers, a move that looks too kind to the Bearkats.
